source.notes: ICSE Class IX school final term examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Final Term Examination 2017-2018', 'Std. : IX A,B,C,D,E', 'Subject : Mathematics', 'Full Marks : 80', 'Time : 2½hrs.+15min.'; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name); durationMinutes 165 = 2½ h + 15 min as printed. Section A (attempt all) Q I-IV; Section B (attempt any four) Q5-Q11, so the pack's marks total exceeds 80. The PDF's text layer contains only the watermark and stray glyphs; text was read from the rendered page images (RapidOCR, corrected against the images) and the mathematical notation rebuilt inline. Every figure area on the rendered pages is blank (the figures did not render or are absent), so questions that depend on a figure are LOW confidence. No marks are printed for III(c), 5(c) and 6(c) (marks 0, LOW). No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
